issues.description: Captures any issues that occurred while deserializing from filesystem

appcuesKey.description: If set, will load appcues with this key.

googleMapsKey.description: If set, will load google maps with this key.

memoryUsagePercentageWarningThresholds.description:
If a workspace reaches or surpasses these memory usage percentages, the user will be presented with a warning alert
banner that prompts them to take action. Each value in the array must have a corresponding translation prefixed
with `ExMachinaManagement.EnvironmentStatus.Status.memoryUsedWarning.`, such as
`ExMachinaManagement.EnvironmentStatus.Status.memoryUsedWarning.90`

workspaceMaxSize.description:
For non-subscription deployments (exMachinaUi), the max workspace size available. For subscription-based
deployments, this will be set on each individual plan.

docsDirectoryPath.description: The path where documentation articles can be found and should therefore also be added in the case of new ones.

acknowledgementsFilePath.description: The path where the Notices & Acknowledgements file can be found.

legalAgreementFilePath.description: The path where the legal agreement can be found.

isPdfConfigured.description:
Enabling this would show the PDF download button to users, thorugh which
users can download the current visualization as a PDF.

requestPendingDaysUntilExpiration.description: The number of days a request can stay pending before it gets automatically declined and marked expired.

defaultMaxSize.description: Default max workspace size for new account members.

defaultStartingSize.description: Default starting workspace size for new account members.

defaultAutoShutdownPeriod.description: Default time after which the environment will be shutdown automatically if idle.

editorsCanModifyShutdown.description: If true, editors can change the shutdown period.
